title: Recover WI-01 through WI-20 audit hosted coverage margin

declaredIntent.summary: Preserve the immutable WI-01 through WI-20 audit while adding behavior-focused fail-closed traceability tests that restore a portable Hosted coverage margin for replacement delivery.

outOfScope: Editing the immutable archived Contract, Summary, or Manifest from wi01-wi20-bidirectional-traceability-audit-20260728
Lowering the 85.10 percent executable coverage threshold, excluding production files, or weakening project-test failure semantics
Changing the completed WI-01 through WI-20 audit result or reopening a closed finding without new contradictory evidence
Implementing other process issues, RFE-ISSUE-082, Japanese evaluation, documentation alignment, release, or plan cleanup

sources.reason: Immutable predecessor Contract and exact scope for the adjacent recovery relationship.
Immutable predecessor verification showing 1333 local tests and 85.102326 percent coverage.
Digest and archive sequence 635 for the predecessor evidence bundle.
Provider-bound Hosted run where all 1333 tests passed but Linux coverage was 85.05 percent and template-smoke failed.
Superseded predecessor PR retained as failed Hosted delivery evidence.
The audited fail-closed checker contains behavior branches that can receive meaningful regression coverage without production changes.
Existing focused suite and the only implementation surface permitted for stable coverage recovery.

riskAssessment.reason: The exact Hosted failure is known, but a coverage-only recovery can become meaningless if it merely exercises lines without validating fail-closed behavior. The predecessor archive must remain immutable and replacement delivery must preserve recovery-chain ownership.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized continuous execution, required process defects to be fixed before later stages, and requested no pause when no new decision is needed.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm predecessor archive sequence 635 and every predecessor byte remain unchanged.
Confirm added tests assert externally meaningful rejection or acceptance behavior rather than only executing lines.
Confirm local coverage has a stable margin above 85.10 percent and Hosted Linux passes the unchanged threshold.
Confirm PR #425 remains closed and the replacement PR is accepted only through the documented adjacent recovery chain.
Confirm later serial stages remain blocked until this recovery is merged and both branches are cleaned.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: Immutable predecessor Contract, Summary, Manifest, archive sequence 635, and closed PR #425 remain unchanged and are cited by the recovery.

A2: New behavior-focused tests cover currently unverified fail-closed traceability paths, including malformed corrective evidence and stale or mismatched archive relationships, without changing production semantics.
A3: The full local suite passes the unchanged 85.10 percent executable threshold with enough margin that the observed 0.052326 percentage-point local-to-Hosted variance would not fail the gate.
A4: Focused traceability checks and the complete twenty-row machine audit still pass with zero open findings; WI-18 and WI-19 remain deferred by the approved order.
A5: Recovery documentation and the instruction traceability registry map the Hosted failure, plan, implementation, acceptance, archive, and provider evidence in both directions.
A6: The recovery receives the sequence immediately after 635 and committed aggregate PR validation accepts the predecessor and recovery only as a human-authorized, source-bound adjacent chain.

A7: The replacement PR passes every required Hosted check including template-smoke and terminal ci-evidence, then merge, ai-close-work-item, predecessor/recovery branch deletion, and main synchronization complete before the process-issues stage starts.
guidelines: Never rewrite superseded archived evidence; recover through one documented adjacent Work Item and replacement PR.
Increase coverage only through behaviorally relevant tests; do not lower thresholds, omit production files, add no-cover markers, or alter success criteria.
Each new test must assert a fail-closed diagnostic or valid recovery relationship that protects instruction-to-acceptance traceability.
Keep the completed audit conclusion stable unless new contradictory repository evidence is discovered.
Record the Hosted failure as a process issue and preserve the fixed eight-stage execution order.

intent.problem: The WI-01 through WI-20 audit passed 1333 local tests at 85.102326 percent and was archived as sequence 635, but replacement delivery PR #425 ran the same 1333 tests on Hosted Linux at 85.05 percent. The unchanged executable threshold is 85.10 percent, so template-smoke and terminal ci-evidence failed. The predecessor local result exceeded the threshold by only 0.002326 percentage points and therefore did not provide a portable verification margin.
constraints: Preserve the predecessor archived bundle and superseded PR #425 as immutable historical evidence.
Do not lower 85.10 percent, exclude production code, weaken CI evidence, or rely on a blind rerun.
Add only behavior-focused regression tests for the audited traceability checker and retain the zero-open-findings conclusion.
Use the documented adjacent recovery-chain exception and complete replacement PR, merge, closure, and branch cleanup before advancing.
intent.rationale: The checker still has untested fail-closed branches for malformed and mismatched evidence. Covering those branches with exact negative regressions improves the audited control and creates a portable margin at the same time. A fresh recovery Work Item keeps the already archived predecessor truthful and makes the Hosted failure part of the governed evidence chain.

rawUserRequest: 继续执行，不要停；每个工单如果发现流程问题先修流程再继续。所有工单都要按“指示—计划—实现—验收”双向追踪机制检查，发布必须在这些对应之后。当前 WI-01～WI-20 审计的 Hosted CI 已完成 1333 tests，但 coverage 85.05% 低于 85.10%；不得改写已归档前序，也不得降低门槛，应建立 replacement recovery 根治稳定余量后完成完整 PR、合并、关闭和分支清理。
